Pomoc · Slovíčko

Help and contact

Slovíčko teaches English speakers Slovak on a road trip from Bratislava to Košice, with Róza the goat as your guide. Below are answers to the questions people ask most. For anything else, a problem, or a mistake you spotted in a lesson, write to us.

Write to us: slovickolearnslovak@gmail.com

I bought the full version. How do I get it back on a new phone or after reinstalling?

Use the same Apple Account (on iPhone) or Google Account (on Android) that you bought it with. Slovíčko usually finds the purchase by itself. If it doesn’t, open the Profil tab → Settings → Full version → Restore purchase.

Apple and Google sell the full version separately, so a purchase made on an iPhone doesn’t unlock Slovíčko on Android, or the other way round.

How do I get a receipt or a refund?

Apple or Google take the payment and send the receipt; we never see your card details.

On iPhone, Apple handles refunds: go to reportaproblem.apple.com and choose Request a refund.

On Android, open your Google Play order history (on play.google.com: your profile picture → Payments & subscriptions → Budget & order history) and choose Report a problem next to the order. If more than 48 hours have passed, or Google sends you to us, write to us with the order number (it starts with GPA.) and we’ll refund it.

What is free, and what does the full version add?

Free for good: the first three stops of the trip (Bratislava, Trnava and Nitra) with all their lessons, dialogues and checkpoints; the alphabet, the numbers game, the calendar, the map, the sayings and the history timeline; practice of every word you learn; all four voices; and a taste of the stories, phrasebook, games and grammar.

The full version is one optional purchase that unlocks the other twelve stops and everything else, for good. There’s no subscription and no ads.

Will my progress move to a new phone?

Slovíčko has no accounts, so your progress is saved only on your phone. If your phone makes backups to iCloud or to your Google account, restoring that backup on a new phone may bring Slovíčko’s progress along.

Deleting the app deletes its progress from the phone, though a phone backup made earlier may still hold a copy (on Android, reinstalling from Google Play can bring it back). The full version always stays with your Apple Account or Google Account.

I don’t like the voice, or I can’t hear anything.

Choose another of the four Slovak voices in the Profil tab → Settings → Voice. If your phone has a Slovak voice of its own, you can pick that there too. If you hear nothing at all, check that your phone’s volume is up. New words are read aloud by themselves only when Speak Slovak automatically is on, in Settings → Learning.

My daily reminder doesn’t arrive.

Turn on Daily reminder in the Profil tab → Settings → Reminders, and allow notifications for Slovíčko in your phone’s settings. The reminder comes from your phone itself, so it works offline.

I found a mistake in a lesson.

Thank you! Write to us with the stop and the lesson, and what it says. A screenshot helps.

Privacy

Slovíčko collects no data: no account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Read the privacy policy.
